title: Next.js dev server runs out of database connections because each hot reload creates a new PrismaClient
symptoms: FATAL: sorry, too many clients already while running next dev
The connection count in pg_stat_activity climbs each time a file is saved
cause: Next.js re-evaluates modules on hot reload, so a module-level new PrismaClient() builds another client and pool each time. With Prisma 7 each pg adapter pool can hold up to 10 connections.
fix: Cache the client on globalThis outside production.
affected: Next.js dev mode with Prisma ORM 6 and 7, as of October 2026
